query: UPDATE tasks SET dueDate = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL FLOOR(RAND() * 30) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') WHERE status = 'open' AND (dueDate IS NULL OR dueDate < CURDATE());
